changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `pin_history` ( `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键ID', `cert_serial_no` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '关联的证书序列号', `pin_hash` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '历史PIN码哈希值', `pin_salt` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'PIN码盐值', `create_time` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `idx_cert_serial_no` (`cert_serial_no`), KEY `idx_create_time` (`create_time`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='PIN码历史记录表';

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ukey_certificate` ( `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键ID', `cert_serial_no` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '证书唯一编号', `certificate_content` text COMMENT '证书内容', `valid_from` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '证书生效时间', `valid_until` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '证书过期时间', `crypto_algorithm` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SM2' COMMENT '加密算法', `bound_client_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '绑定的客户端ID', `cert_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL' COMMENT '证书状态', `issuer` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '证书颁发机构', `subject` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '证书主体信息', `remark` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备注', `create_time` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '录入时间', `update_time` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间', `online_status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OFFLINE' COMMENT '在线状态', `last_auth_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最近认证成功时间', `last_offline_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最近离线时间', `display_name` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'UKey显示名称', `pin_hash` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'UKey PIN码哈希值', `pin_salt` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'PIN码盐值', `pin_update_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'PIN码最后更新时间', `last_heartbeat_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客户端最近心跳时间', `client_ip` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '客户端最近上报IP', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `cert_serial_no` (`cert_serial_no`), KEY `idx_cert_serial_no` (`cert_serial_no`), KEY `idx_bound_client_id` (`bound_client_id`), KEY `idx_cert_status` (`cert_status`), KEY `idx_online_status` (`online_status`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='UKey证书管理表';
